notes.title: Undo Button Added
notes.notes:
You can now undo your last move. Just press the 'X' key on your keyboard or press the 'B' button on a gamepad (Xbox 360 style controller). This should make the game less frustrating. 

Also fixed the bug where barrels and crates could block the lever.

notes.title: Joystick Controls added
notes.notes:
You can now control the cat with the left analogue joystick on the xbox style controller - the dogs movement will be inverted. 
You can now control the dog with the right analogue joystick on the xbox style controller - the cats movement will be inverted.
